profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at M3
profile.summary: I am a determined professional with a proven track record as a Software Developer. Additionally, I possess creativity, resourcefulness, and effective problem-solving skills. Furthermore, I excel as a team player and have great adaptability to changes, and extensive experience in system development for the accounting and media sectors.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Skills: .NET Core · Angular · Git · Docker · Problem Solving

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description:
Improved software efficiency by troubleshooting and resolving coding issues. 
Create unit tests to save time and resources by identifying and fixing bugs before product deployment. Collaborated with the QA team and other devs to deliver high-quality products on tight deadlines. 
Enhanced user experience through designing and implementing user-friendly interfaces using Angular, Angular Materials, and AG-Grid. 
Participated in regular refinements, contributing to the design of new features and enhancements for our application. 
Collaborated closely with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve system bottlenecks, ensuring smoother releases. 
Troubleshoot Ansible playbooks and collaborate with DevOps on any deployment issue. 
Mentored junior developers to improve their technical skills, fostering a culture of continuous learning within the team

positions.title: Software Specialist
positions.description:
Created and designed Rest APIs to receive data from different feeds to update the media metadata in our Media quality control system. 
Maintained, and supported current applications according to the organization's requirements and needs. Migrated Fox Network data to adapt Disney requirements

positions.title: Broadcast software specialist
positions.description:
Designed, developed, and maintained a Media quality control system, that helps to track every media, allowing the operations department to create, assign, and track every movie and ad scheduled for broadcasting. 
Created and designed Rest APIs to receive data from different feeds to update the media metadata in our Media quality control system. 
Optimized database structures and queries to enhance data retrieval speeds, improving application response times significantly. Maintained current ad-sales applications and reports to support operations in our Latam offices

positions.title: IT Specialist
positions.description:
Created and maintained applications and provided technical support. Designed and developed a Web interface with SAP to manage the inventory, reducing the inventory process from 4 days to 8 hours. Designed and implemented a web application to control the production process, reducing the
costs of production by over 7% in 6 months

positions.title: Web Developer (Remote)
positions.description: Designed and implemented new applications, maintained and supported current applications and provided technical support to 25 employees and external customers.

positions.title: Web Developer (Remote)
positions.description:
Designed new applications, maintained and supported current applications and provide technical support to 30 employees and all external customers. Developed and designed multi-tenant Applications allowing
customers to create a website and online store.

positions.title: Web Developer / DBA
positions.description:
Responsible for providing DBA and Programming support to Affinity Clients as assigned.

DBA responsibilities include: 
•	Execute backup and restore of internal client databases
•	Detach and Attaching of databases for testing and deployment
•	Ensuring normalization of client databases 
•	Performed performance tuning of several client databases
•	Responsible for writing Stored Procedures and Triggers

Programming responsibilities include:
•	Develop specifications for new system modules 
•	Modification of existing application 
•	Programming of both VB.NET and ASP.NET modules in support of client side and portal based applications. 
•	Use of Web services to provide real-time user updates from client trusted database to a public web portal. 

Technical Skills Used:
•	SQL Server 2000, ASP.NET, VB.NET, XML, Web Services

positions.title: Developer / Database Administrator
positions.description:
Responsible for database administration and programming of the company web site. 

DBA responsibilities included:
"	Management of 3 SQL Server database instances on two separate servers
"	All Backup and Restore needs
"	Setting up DTS packages for data imports
"	Programming of all Stored Procedures, Triggers and Rules
"	Performance Monitoring and Tuning of all databases - re-indexing and rebuilding of indexes, clearing of logs
"	Setup and maintenance of database security and users
"	Programming and running of special jobs to migrate and synchronize each database

Developer / Analyst responsibilities included:
"	Responsible for designing, programming and implementing a web site which allows customers to check their call record, bill review, online payments and subscribe to a new service. 
"	Defined the company needs and users, expectations by applying formative research methodologies such as participatory design and analysis. 
"	Create design alternatives through evaluation of prototypes. 
"	Initiated design reviews, surveys and visits to identify the company needs and users expectations. 
"	Worked together with the marketing Department to create strategies that successfully promote the use and sales of the company products through the web increasing sales by 30%. 
"	Utilized SQL server, Active Reports and ASP.NET to develop the web and Internet Programs. 
"	Write interfaces (XML Web Services, Web Programs) within billing system, allowing all customers make payments and unblock theirs account online increasing collection rate by 50%. 
"	Provide support as needed to all company software products as well as operational aspects of the customer service department.

positions.title: Web DEveloper
positions.description:
Responsible of creation of Classes and components on VB6 (business rules) to Access the database and stored procedures through ASP.

•	Responsible of  Write stored procedures and triggers  
•	Create some Web interfaces in asp
•	Create a Shopping cart for Online Store using Intershop 3.0 and html.
•	Supply assistance with all hardware and software installations.

Technical Skills Used:
•	SQL Server 2000, ASP, VB6, SQL, Intershop, HTML

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Assigned to PDVSA (oil Company of Venezuela).
Responsible for the development of systems for the financial department requirements with VB6 and oracle 8. 
•	Develop programs in VB6 and Oracle for the generation of financial reports to the general manager of finances. 
•	Develop programs using VB6 and Oracle to control the Risk of investment on Oil explorations.

Assigned to INTESA 
•	Write programs in asp and oracle to create the company site.
•	Write ASP Pages that allow buy of some products online (shopping cart), send invoices to the client via email and send a purchase order to the business (B2B).

Technical Skills Used:
•	Oracle, ASP, VB6, SQL

positions.title: VB Programmer
positions.description:
Assigned to PDVSA (Oil Company of Venezuela)
•	Test, fix, and to adapt to year 2000 financial applications created with clipper, fox pro and VB 3.0.
•	Write, test and modify programs in VB 3.0 to control an employees dinning to be year 2000 compliant.
•	Write programs in VB6 and Sql server, which load and display telephone billing information.

Technical Skills Used:
•	SQL Server, Visual Baisc

positions.title: Programmer I
positions.description:
•	Write a Salary Survey program, able to calculate different metrics with the salaries and benefits of multiple companies, allowing the consultants to evaluate how their customers' compensation is compared with the market.
•	Write SQL Server Scripts to create Statistical Reports.
•	Write data extraction programs to user specifications using BCP and SQL.
•	Write and modify programs in VB 3.0 to create and maintain a Salary survey System.
•	Create programs to read Security Keys to be assigned to our customers.
•	Create and maintain Setup and installation kits, including security Key programming.
•	Supply assistance with all hardware and software installations for personal computers and servers.

Technical Skills Used:
•	SQL Server, Visual Basic, SQL

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
Design and create programs to manage, scan, and store images, allowing the users to search the images for multiples keys. The system allow to reduce the paper use and reduce the storage of old images in 60%, All the programs and modules were developed programs in VB and Sybase.

• Developed programs in VB and Sybase to manage Retirement funds of a bank.
